 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the line and the separate shape, then draw the continuation line
    # on the far side of the shape, perpendicular to the guide line.
    solid_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    solid_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if solid_row is not None:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (grid[solid_row][0], max(set(sum(grid, [])), key=sum(row.count(max(set(sum(grid, [])), key=sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))) for row in grid))) ]
        # Determine object color as the non-background color other than the line.
        counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in set(sum(grid, []))}
        bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
        color = min((v for v in counts if v not in (bg, grid[solid_row][0])), key=lambda v: counts[v])
        rr = [r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        target = max(rr) + 1
        if target < h:
            out[target] = [8] * w
    elif solid_col is not None:
        counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in set(sum(grid, []))}
        bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
        color = min((v for v in counts if v not in (bg, grid[0][solid_col])), key=lambda v: counts[v])
        cc = [c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        target = max(cc) + 1
        if target < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][target] = 8
    return out
",
